name: [👿⚔️] KPop Demon Hunters
desc:
The Official KPop Demon Hunters Roblox game, brought to you by Netflix and Twin Atlas!

Join HUNTR/X in an action-packed experience where music and combat collide.
Build your KPop Idol, protect the fans and save the Honmoon.
Unlock fresh fits, new gear, apartment customizations and pets along your journey as you fight demons.

Live out your dream life as a KPop star!

llm.loop: build a KPop idol -> fight demons and protect fans -> earn gear, fits and pets -> customize apartment
llm.objectives: protect the fans and save the Honmoon as a KPop demon hunter
llm.progression: outfits, gear, pets, apartment customizations, gems and charms
llm.instructions: join HUNTR/X, build your idol, fight demons, unlock fits, gear, apartment items and pets
unique: official Netflix licensed IP mixing music and combat
llm.thumbnails: official character art of HUNTR/X with mics and weapons, a wardrobe of outfits, Netflix branding, demon tiger icon
llm.video: 1 video on page, content not shown
llm.complexity_notes: licensed studio build, custom character models, combat, customization and housing systems
